title: Counting the Response Days of a Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Request for Mail and Phone Applicants
content:
**Rule.** On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, how the response days counted so far are counted depends on how the applicant deals with the laboratory:

1. **Application received by mail.** The response days are counted as business days from the request date.
2. **Application taken by phone, from an applicant who has made no portal payment in the last twelve whole months and has made a mail or phone payment in that time.** The request goes out by mail, and the response days are counted as calendar days from the next business day after the request date: the following Monday for a request issued on a Friday or a Saturday, the next day otherwise.
3. **Any other application.** This rule does not change how the response days are counted.

**Counting business days.** When the response days are counted as business days, each full five of them span seven calendar days, any remainder spans as many calendar days, and two more calendar days are added when the remainder runs past a Friday. The remainder runs past a Friday when the day reached by adding the remainder to the request date falls after the Friday of the request date's own week, weeks running Monday to Sunday.

**Records read.** How the application was received is the application channel on the case. Payments are read from the household's Patient Invoices & Statements: a portal payment is one made through the online portal; a mail or phone payment is one made by mail, through the automated phone line or with a phone agent; "the last twelve whole months" takes payments dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today.

The count reached is the number of calendar days from the request date to the documents due date.

## Worked weeks (hypothetical response days counted so far: 32)

| Application | Request date | Count | Calendar days to the due date | Due date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Received by mail | Wednesday 2 September 2026 | Six full fives span 42 days; remainder 2 reaches Friday, not past it | 44 | Friday 16 October 2026 |
| Received by mail | Thursday 3 September 2026 | Six full fives span 42 days; remainder 2 reaches Saturday, past Friday, so 2 more days | 46 | Monday 19 October 2026 |
| Taken by phone, mail-and-phone payer | Friday 4 September 2026 | Counted from the following Monday, 3 days later | 35 | Friday 9 October 2026 |
| Taken by phone, mail-and-phone payer | Wednesday 2 September 2026 | Counted from the next day | 33 | Monday 5 October 2026 |
